title: Gyidi a Ɛwɔ Ahengua no Akyi
intro: Ɛnyɛ ogya anaa nsuyiri na ɛsɔ akra binom hwɛ, na mmom nhyɛso a ɛne sɛ wɔbɛtra otirimɔdenfo ahemfie mu nkakrankakra. Ná saa onipa yi gyina sodifo bi a ɔkyerɛ sɛ ɔyɛ onyame wɔ wɔn nkurɔfo so, nanso wɔbata Nokware Nyankopɔn Baako no mu gyidi ho wɔ kokoam no nkyɛn. Bere a wohuu wɔn ahofama no, amanehunu bae — nanso ɔsoro bɔhyɛ bi nso bae. So wubetumi asusuw onii ko a eyi yɛ ho?
clues: Ná mete m’asase so sodifo a ɔwɔ tumi sen biara no atifi, wɔ gyinabea a nnipa kakraa bi betumi asusuw ho.
Me hokafoɔ gyinaa nkurɔfoɔ no anim na ɔkaa sɛ ɔyɛ onyame — nanso na m’akoma yɛ Nokware Awurade Baako no dea.
Mebɔɔ mpae wɔ kokoam, na na misuro asotwe a ɛba wɔn a wɔsɔre tia me hokafo nyinaa so no.
Bere a wɔdaa me gyidi adi no, wɔkyeree me na wɔyɛɛ me ayayade — nanso me tɛkrɛma anka asɛm biara a ɛkyerɛ sɛ minnye nni da.
Mehwiee m’akoma mu kyerɛɛ m’Awurade, srɛɛ ofie wɔ Paradise, a ɛne bɔne nyinaa ntam kwan ware.
Me ne Asiya bint Muzahim — Farao yere a ɔsɔre tiaa Musa ne Harun.

arabic: وَضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ فِرْعَوْنَ إِذْ قَالَتْ رَبِّ ٱبْنِ لِى عِندَكَ بَيْتًۭا فِى ٱلْجَنَّةِ وَنَجِّنِى مِن فِرْعَوْنَ وَعَمَلِهِۦ وَنَجِّنِى مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verse: And Allāh presents an example of those who believed: the wife of Pharaoh, when she said, "My Lord, build for me near You a house in Paradise and save me from Pharaoh and his deeds and save me from the wrongdoing people." (66:11)
